facts.fact: No GST is charged on sleeper class or second class (reserved and unreserved) fares
facts.quote: GST is not applicable in other classes like second sleeper, second class (reserved & unreserved) etc.

facts.fact: GST applies only to AC and First class fares, on all categories of trains
facts.quote: GST is applicable on total fare of AC and First class only of all categories of trains.

summary: Confirmed on the Railways GST FAQ; indianrailways.gov.in/GST/FAQs.pdf now shows an 'under construction' page, the same FAQ is at ir.indianrailways.gov.in/GST/FAQs.pdf.
